answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the anchor of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A plume of per-task receipts records who did what, and the zephyr of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on time-locked work history, capped per identity per epoch, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
